title: Redesigning christoph-rumpel.com
content:
<html><head></head><body>There might come a time when your personal website doesn't reflect your work or especially yourself anymore. At this point you have to think about changes and probably a redesign is what will solve all your problems. At least this is what was best in my case. This article will give you an overview of the process of redesigning christoph-rumpel.com. It will show you how I planned this project and what I have learned on the way. But let us start at the beginning. This is what my site looked like in December 2012.
            </body></html>
